title.rendered: A Spirit of Power, Love, and a Sound Mind: The Gospel For Today

content.rendered:
God did not give you a spirit of fear. He gave you a spirit of power, of love and of a sound mind. Fear is not your birthright. Soundness is.

The Gospel For Today | Wednesday, June 24, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.”
2 Timothy 1:7 (NIV)

Today’s Message

The King James translation of this verse gives us the phrase that has stayed with the church for centuries. God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, of love and of a sound mind. The NIV renders the third gift as self-discipline. Other translations say self-control. The Greek word, sophronismos, carries all of it. A mind that is whole. A mind that is sound. A mind that knows itself, governs itself, and is not at the mercy of every passing emotion or external pressure.

Paul is writing to Timothy, a young pastor who is nervous. Possibly afraid. Probably overwhelmed by what God has called him to. And Paul reaches into the spiritual inventory God has already given him, and names what is there. Not fear. Power, love and a sound mind. Three gifts already on deposit, given by the Spirit at the moment of new birth, available to be drawn on whenever the situation requires.

The sound mind matters in this set because it is the integrating gift. Power without a sound mind becomes recklessness. Love without a sound mind becomes co-dependency. The sound mind is what makes power steady and love wise. It is the inner faculty that keeps the believer from being tossed around by every wind, every panic, every spike of emotion, every pressure from people. It is the gift that lets a person stay themselves under pressure.

A sound mind is not the absence of feelings. The believer with a sound mind still feels grief, still feels joy, still feels disappointment, still feels longing. The difference is that the sound mind is not run by those feelings. It feels them, names them, brings them under the lordship of Christ, and continues to do what is right regardless. The feelings are passengers. The sound mind drives.

If you are a believer who has been told, sometimes by Christians, that you are anxious by nature, that you cannot help your panic, that fear is just who you are, hear Paul again. God did not give you that spirit. He gave you another spirit altogether. Power. Love. A sound mind. The fear you have been carrying may have come from a thousand sources, but it did not come from God. And by the Spirit, you can give it back.

Prayer

Father, thank You that You have not given me a spirit of fear. You have given me Your Spirit, who pours into me power, love and a sound mind. Today I refuse to live as if fear is my inheritance. I draw on the gifts already on deposit by Your Spirit. Make my mind sound, integrated and steady under pressure. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

God has not given me a spirit of fear. He has given me a spirit of power, of love, and of a sound mind. I am not run by my feelings. I am led by the Spirit. My mind is whole and stable in Christ Jesus.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • 2 Timothy 1:6-14: Fan into flame the gift of God
  • Romans 8:15: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves to fear
  • Isaiah 41:10: Do not fear, for I am with you
